notes.dedupe: identical token prefixes are encoded once and share the vector, so an unedited input starting with the opening is at distance exactly 0 from its signature
notes.opening: common token prefix (no special tokens, this tokenizer, capped at 254 tokens) of the template with inputs 'A B' and 'zzq xkj'
notes.Z: share of paraphrased inputs whose distance to their own signature is <= radius
notes.benchmark_zone_certified_routed: in_own_zone = dist to own signature <= r; certified_own = some zone contains the input and the route is the own task; routed_own = route is the own task (certified or nearest)

view_d_benchmark.note: light/medium/heavy exist only for the five tasks with rewordings (sr.REWORDED); in 'fifteen' they cover those five only

view_f_cost.note: sequential, one input at a time, no cache; includes tokenisation, all prefix encodings, distances to 700 signatures, route
